title: readStructuredGrid
body:
## readStructuredGrid

Reads one VTK XML structured grid file (.vts) into vtkStructuredGrid: a curvilinear i-j-k grid with explicit point coordinates and implicit hexahedral (or quadrilateral) connectivity. Use it for body-fitted structured meshes, e.g. multi-block CFD grids exported block by block. For axis-aligned grids use readRectilinearGrid or readImageData; for arbitrary cells use readUnstructuredGrid.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Coordinates are in whatever unit the writer used; nothing is converted.
- Every array is read; use the generated pvXMLStructuredGridReader binding to select arrays on large grids.

Native constructor: `XMLStructuredGridReader`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `files` | The list of files to be read by the reader. Each file is expected to be in the VTK XML structured grid data format. The standard extension is .vts. If more than one file is specified, the reader will switch to file series mode in which it will pretend that it can support time and provide one file per time step. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"minItems":1,"maxItems":1}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "readStructuredGrid",
  "options": {
    "files": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ]
  }
}
```
